info.name: The 2010 Winter King / Winter Queen Event!

descriptions.notStarted: Winter is here, and the chilly cold is already affecting everyone! If you wish to become the Winter King or Winter Queen of 2010, you'd better go see Cassandra.
descriptions.inProgress: Cassandra says she'll give you a Winter King or Winter Queen medal that can be used until midnight.
descriptions.completed: If you get more than 20 of these medals from Cassandra, then Cassandra will give you a medal that won't expire for 30 days.
